piezas.titulo: Production practice: Reports, data and synthesis
texto: Integrated conversation: presenting the results of a technical report to an advisory committee. At Superior level you are assessed on your ability to synthesise numerical data without losing rigour, to accept the limited scope of the sample naturally, and to suggest future lines of research in impeccable academic language. Use formal markers such as «จากข้อค้นพบเบื้องต้น» (based on the preliminary findings) and «จำเป็นต้องมีการวิจัยเพิ่มเติม» (further research is necessary).

opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ข้อเสนอแนะในรายงานควรมีความเป็นไปได้ในทางปฏิบัติและสอดคล้องกับงบประมาณ» from the text.

opciones.texto: Presenting statistics in chart form helps readers see trends of change.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Comparing data from two periods reveals progress and the key variables involved.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
